rounds.text: The statistical anomalies of a 0.15 P/E ratio and a 0.00x price-to-book multiple with a share price of ₹ 7.50 against a book value of ₹ 3,493 are not bargains, but rather symptoms of a profound market disconnect and severe underlying illiquidity [E1, E2]. Filed statements explicitly flag this poor five-year sales trajectory of -4.03% as a negative fundamental development [E47]. Furthermore, shareholders receive zero cash return, with the dividend yield standing strictly at 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: the company displays a positive 3-year compounded sales growth of 1%, alongside scanX signal engine screen reasons indicating year-over-year sales growth above 20% and profit growth exceeding 20% [E15, E50, E53].
